The algorithm iteratively refines the probe sphere until it converges on an intersection or the probe radius falls below $\epsilon$.
Construct a probe sphere centered at $c = \tau + \omega s$ with radius $s$.
Advance the ray origin by the sphere's diameter: $\tau \leftarrow \tau + \omega (2s)$.
Increase the probe radius for the next iteration to traverse empty areas faster: $s \leftarrow s \cdot \xi_{bonus}$.
Keep $\tau$ unchanged to re-evaluate a smaller probe at the same location.
